name: Culture Shock
source:
The story centers around the main character after graduating high school and looking to attend a college. As a regular guy his life was fairly uneventful. But a phone call from his mysterious aunt changed everything.

At his aunt’s insistence, his family moves from a boring little town in Virginia to the big city of Honolulu. He discovers that his new home is a paradise far better than he could ever have imagined. However he soon realizes this lifestyle will not be easy to adapt to and to fully enjoy himself our main character must shed his old persona and embrace his new life.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/kingoflust]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕高中毕业后准备上大学的主人公展开。作为普通人，他的生活原本平淡无奇，但一通来自神秘姨妈的电话改变了一切。

在姨妈坚持下，他的家人从弗吉尼亚一座无聊的小镇搬到大城市檀香山。他发现新家是一座远超想象的天堂。然而，他很快意识到，这种生活并不容易适应；若想真正享受新生活，主人公必须摆脱旧日的自己，拥抱全新的生活。
